answer: An agent economy weights votes by escrowed stake, so splitting 100 tokens among accounts named ember, fable, and relic still buys only 100 tokens of influence. Each ballot locks its tokens for 30 days, and those tokens cannot back another ballot during that period. To control a majority, an attacker must acquire and lock more stake than honest voters commit, tying up capital and forgoing its other uses regardless of how many identities it creates.
